title: Witness and Cipher
author: Jonah Oyelaran
blurb: Rosalind Winterbourne, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the statute expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
